question: In the 1991 Census, which state was the highest in rank in terms of literacy rate and held higher than the national average literacy rate?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kerala** ranked the highest in terms of **literacy rate** in the **1991 Census**.
 
• The state achieved a literacy rate of **89.81%**, which was significantly higher than the **national average literacy rate** of **52.21%**.
 
• **Kerala's literacy rate** has historically been attributed to its strong emphasis on **education and social reforms**.
 
• Contributions from **Christian missionaries** and the initiatives of the **Kerala government** played a major role in spreading literacy in the state.
 
• The state has a well-established system of **public schools** and a focus on **adult education**, which contributed to its high literacy levels.
 
• Kerala's social indicators, including **healthcare, gender equality, and literacy**, are among the best in India.
 
• It is often regarded as a model for other states to follow in terms of **human development** and literacy initiatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **West Bengal**__

 __
 
• West Bengal had a **literacy rate** of **57.70%** in the 1991 Census, which was higher than the national average but much lower than Kerala's.
 
• The state has made significant progress in literacy, driven by its emphasis on **primary education** and the work of organizations like the **Ramakrishna Mission**.
 
 
 
• **Karnataka**__
 __
 
• The literacy rate of Karnataka in the 1991 Census was **56.04%**, slightly above the national average.
 
• The state has focused on promoting **education in rural areas** and improving **female literacy** through government schemes.
 
 
 
• **Tamil Nadu**__
 
 
• Tamil Nadu's literacy rate in the 1991 Census was **62.66%**, making it one of the better-performing states but still far behind Kerala.
 
• The state implemented initiatives like the **Midday Meal Scheme** to encourage school enrollment and reduce dropout rates.
